I can't find a `justfile` in this checkout, so I can't tell you the recipe name. The `Makefile` is still in the repo on `main` (clean, latest commit `f43b7c9`), so the switch to `just` probably lives on another branch or hasn't been merged yet.

Here's what "fast tests" meant in the old setup (`Makefile:3-4`):

```make
test-fast:
	pytest -m "not postgres" -q
```

You can run that directly whatever the task runner is:

```sh
pytest -m "not postgres" -q
```

This skips the tests marked `postgres`, so you don't need the database running. The full suite (`pytest -q`, or `just test` now) needs `docker compose up db` first.

If the new `justfile` copied the Makefile targets, the command is probably `just test-fast`. Run `just --list` to see the actual recipe names.

The project memory still says "Run tests with `make test-fast`." I haven't changed it because the Makefile is still on `main`. Once the `just` migration is merged, tell me the recipe name and I'll update the memory.
